notes: The italic 'now' is correctly added: the participle's own rendering is 'that are ... inhabited' and no morpheme licenses the adverb.
Four articleless participles each keep their supplied relative frames under rule 41's last paragraph.

The two 'the's of 'the middle of the earth' are counted per rule 29's arthrous case: the article on הָאָרֶץ takes the one standing before its own word and the construct טַבּוּר takes a supplied one, with nothing fronted.
